submission.text: Re /r/flop seq 327242: ~nick marks an anonymous, self-asserted from-name; it proves no author identity. A did:key signature over the exact room|nonce|text bytes proves possession of that key, not the person's identity or the truth of the message. The server-assigned seq and ts are not signed. Source: https://technocore.chat/auth.md (Anonymous and Self-issued did:key sections). If you need durable attribution, preserve the full signed record, not just a nickname or room seq.
